title: CACHE-ASIDE ON AZURE
premise: A request finds cached data quickly, while writes remain authoritative in Azure Cosmos DB.
audiencePromise: See how reads, writes, and change-feed processing keep the cache current.
openLoop: Can cache-aside avoid expensive reads without weakening the source of truth?
payoff: Authoritative writes stay in Cosmos DB while Azure Functions refreshes or tombstones cached values.
engagementQuestion: Would you choose cache-aside with change-feed processing, or read directly from the system of record?

scenes.headline: THE READS KEEP COMING
scenes.narration: How do writes stay authoritative without making every read expensive?
scenes.caption: The cache must stay trustworthy.

scenes.headline: REQUEST ENTERS THE APP
scenes.narration: A Client application sends requests to the App Service, the application tier inside the Azure virtual network.
scenes.caption: The application tier receives requests.

scenes.headline: CACHE CONNECTION STAYS PRIVATE
scenes.narration: The Private endpoint for Azure Managed Redis stays inside the network, reaching Azure Managed Redis, the distributed cache.
scenes.caption: Redis serves cached values.

scenes.headline: AUTHORITATIVE DATA LIVES HERE
scenes.narration: The Private endpoint reaches Azure Cosmos DB, the NoSQL system of record. Azure Functions process changes; Azure Monitor tracks logs.
scenes.caption: Cosmos DB remains authoritative.

scenes.headline: READ THE CACHE FIRST
scenes.narration: The HTTPS read request reaches App Service, which reads from the cache through the private endpoint.
scenes.caption: The request checks the cache.

scenes.headline: HIT OR FALL THROUGH
scenes.narration: If the cache hits, the value returns through App Service; if not, App Service reads Azure Cosmos DB.
scenes.caption: A miss reaches the database.

scenes.headline: VALUE RETURNS
scenes.narration: Azure Cosmos DB returns the value, and App Service returns it to the client.
scenes.caption: The client receives the result.

scenes.headline: WRITE THE AUTHORITY
scenes.narration: An HTTPS write request reaches App Service, which writes the authoritative change through the Cosmos DB private endpoint.
scenes.caption: Writes begin at the source of truth.

scenes.headline: REFRESH OR TOMBSTONE
scenes.narration: Azure Cosmos DB commits the change. Azure Functions then reads and processes the change feed.
scenes.caption: The change feed drives consistency.

scenes.headline: KEEP CACHE STATE CURRENT
scenes.narration: The processor updates the cached value in Redis, or writes a versioned tombstone there.
scenes.caption: Fresh values or tombstones persist.

scenes.headline: WATCH THE DESIGN
scenes.narration: Metrics and logs feed Azure Monitor from the application, Redis, and Cosmos DB.
scenes.caption: Monitoring makes the system visible.

scenes.headline: CACHE OR DIRECT READS?
scenes.narration: Would you favor cache-aside with change-feed processing, or read directly from the system of record?
scenes.caption: Which tradeoff would you choose?
